theme.description: Dark-first, 'Swiss Brutalist' meets 'Performance Pro' aesthetic optimized for high-density financial data. Prioritizes readability during long sessions, using off-white text and charcoal surfaces with semantic color accents.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard, but favor generous padding (p-6, p-8) within widgets for breathability despite dense data.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. Base grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, labels, and numbers (using tabular-nums). Avoid center-alignment on data widgets.

components.cards: Minimalist bento boxes. Background #141415, 1px solid border-white/10, rounded-md (4px or 8px max). NO drop shadows. Flat, crisp edges.
components.buttons: Sharp edges or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Hover states must lighten background and text. Primary button uses brand blue or warning yellow for actions.
components.ai_drawer: Side sheet (Shadcn Sheet component). Elevated background (#1C1C1E) with subtle inner border. Use a 'Tracing Beam' or subtle glowing border to indicate AI context.
components.charts: Recharts via Shadcn chart wrappers. Use dark-mode specific semantic colors for series. Gridlines must be extremely subtle (stroke-white/5).
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Clean row separators (border-b border-white/5). Tabular figures for all costs. Align amounts to right.
components.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a sharp, technical aesthetic.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky headers or floating navs. bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-b border-white/10. NO fully transparent headers.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Subtle -translate-y-[1px] and border-white/20 on card hover. Smooth accordion for recommendations.
visual_enhancers.data_density: Use progressive disclosure. Show summary metric, reveal drill-down details via hover or click.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Off-white on charcoal passes comfortably.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Avoid heavy parallax in data-heavy screens.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (ring-2 ring-blue-500 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#0A0A0B]) on all inputs.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based.

login_background.description: Abstract data visualization for the login screen background overlay.

ai_avatar.description: Glowing AI letters to be used as the avatar for the Copilot in the chat drawer.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a dark-first theme using Tailwind classes (bg-[#0A0A0B]).
Use IBM Plex Sans for all numeric data and tabular displays to ensure vertical alignment of financial figures.
Construct the dashboard using the Bento grid protocol (MODE B) for high density.
Integrate Shadcn components for forms, tables, and dialogs, stripping out default styling to match the flat, border-driven aesthetic.
Build the AI Copilot as a persistent, accessible side drawer using Framer Motion for entry/exit.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
Never use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Create depth via overlapping surfaces (bg-[#141415] on bg-[#0A0A0B]).
Install required fonts and libraries: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react recharts framer-motion lucide-react sonner
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply universal transition: all. Use specific transitions.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded) with distinct hover states.
Never use emoji characters (🤖, etc.) for icons. Use the specified icon library.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, and forms for testing.
